answer: Rotate the session key after each completed task, bind the new key to the task hash, and weight every identity by the length of its independent attestation path. Draw quorum seats from separate subnets so one hosting provider cannot fill a panel. Break it and watch what fails first: a cloned key stops working at the next rotation, and short paths score near zero. A river of accounts needs long unrelated paths per account, which means real counterparties. Keys come from cheap quartz. A walnut shell around an empty identity is still empty.
